text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.
You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because I had a wonderful day off.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I was taking care of my gems. I wanted to 
take my time and do it right, if possible.
choice_data_list:
What kind of things do you do for 
"maintenance"?

What kind of things do you do for 
"maintenance"?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... For some, you use warm water 
and a brush, and for things that shouldn't 
get wet, you wipe them dry. It depends on 
the material, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's fun, like we're having a 
conversation. The more we do it, the 
deeper our bond feels...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Facing each and every one of them leaves 
me with a deep sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems I'm the one being helped 
by those children.

It looks like Victoire Pisa had a 
wonderful rest.
